title: Influence bound for influential coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $\\tau$ be any real number. If $S$ is the set of coordinates whose influence is at least $\\tau$, then $|S|\\tau\\leq I$, where $I$ is the total influence of the associated real-valued function.
